title: 第77章 借势定局，大势已成！

第77章 借势定局，大势已成！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

方志远没走。

文件是产业审查科盖的章，红章。

流程上合法合规。就算齐家在北京有能量，也得走复议程序，最少拖三十天。

三十天，够了。

“林总。”

方志远压住嗓子里的颤，把语气掰回正轨。

“您有异议可以走行政复议，但在此之前——签约必须暂停。”

他顿了一下，看向齐衡。

“至于齐先生那边的项目诉求，我完全尊重。中投信达也可以帮忙协调，换一个园区落地——”

“不用。”

齐衡没抬头，把钢笔帽旋上，搁在协议旁边。

“我的项目只落张江。”

方志远脸皮绷了一下。

还想说什么，门被推开了。

两个人走进来。

前面那位五十出头，深灰中山装，头发梳得一丝不苟。

后面跟着陆卫国，黑色夹克，手里拿着公文包。

会议室十几个人同时抬头。

送文件的审查科办事员看清来人，腿一软，嘴张了两下没叫出声。

方志远认出了前面那个人。

不是认识。是在新闻和内参照片上见过。

上海市主管经济，环保的副市长，许正和。

他的喉结滚了一下。

许正和进来之后，视线在会议室转了一圈。

先看林川，微微点头。

扫过方锐、齐衡、叶知秋，最后落在审查科办事员手里那份文件上。

“这就是那份调查通知？”

不是问句。

办事员哆嗦着把文件递过去。

许正和翻开，看了十秒。递给身后的陆卫国。

陆卫国扫了两眼，合上，把文件搁在桌面上。

“签发日期昨天，从立案到出文一天。没有分管领导会签，没有举报附件，没有举报人信息。”

他的手指在封面上点了一下。

“这不叫调查通知。这叫白条。”

审查科办事员的脸白透了。

方志远往前迈了半步。

“许市长，陆局——我们中投信达只是例行关注张江的优质项目，这次是受管委会邀请——”

“你是哪个单位的？”陆卫国转头。

“中投信达产业基金，副总裁，方志远。”

“中投信达。”陆卫国的语调平得像念报纸，“那你出现在一份区级产业审查科的合规调查现场，代表什么身份来参与调查？”

方志远的话堵住了。

他不是审查科的人。文件也不是他出的。他只是“跟着来”的。

但“跟着来”这三个字说出口，等于承认自己是这场闹剧的推手。

不说，又解释不了为什么站在这里。

陆卫国没等他。

“不方便回答就不用回答。”

一句话，路堵死了。

许正和开口。

“张江三号研发楼的半导体原材料本地化项目，我看过材料了。”

他看了一眼齐衡。

“齐先生的团队专程从北京过来对接，这个项目如果能在张江落地量产，对整个长三角半导体供应链的成本结构会产生实质性的优化。不是一个普通的招商项目。”

视线移回林川。

Chapter 77: Taking advantage of the situation, the situation is settled!- "Rebirth 2000: I broke the agreement and became rich"

Fang Zhiyuan didn't leave.

The document is stamped by the Industrial Examination Section, a red seal.

The process is legal and compliant.Even if the Qi family has energy in Beijing, they still have to go through the reconsideration process, which will drag on for at least thirty days.

Thirty days is enough.

"Mr. Lin."

Fang Zhiyuan suppressed the tremor in his throat and got his tone back on track.

"If you have objections, you can go to administrative review, but before that - the signing must be suspended."

He paused and looked at Qi Heng.

"As for Mr. Qi's project demands, I completely respect them. CIC Cinda can also help coordinate and change the location to another park——"

"No need."

Qi Heng did not raise his head, screwed on the pen cap and placed it next to the agreement.

“My project only goes to Zhangjiang.”

Fang Zhiyuan's face tightened.

He was about to say something else when the door was pushed open.

Two people walked in.

The man in front is in his early fifties, wearing a dark gray Mao suit, and his hair is combed meticulously.

Followed by Lu Weiguo, wearing a black jacket and holding a briefcase in his hand.

More than a dozen people in the conference room looked up at the same time.

The clerk from the examination section who was delivering the documents saw the person clearly. His legs went weak and he opened his mouth twice without making a sound.

Fang Zhiyuan recognized the person in front of him.

Not acquaintance.I saw it in the news and internal reference photos.

Xu Zhenghe, deputy mayor of Shanghai in charge of economy and environmental protection.

His Adam's apple rolled.

After Xu Zhenghe came in, his eyes moved around the conference room.

He looked at Lin Chuan first and nodded slightly.

After scanning Fang Rui, Qi Heng, and Ye Zhiqiu, he finally landed on the document in the hands of the clerk in the examination department.

"Is this the investigation notice?"

Not a question.

The clerk handed over the documents tremblingly.

Xu Zhenghe opened it and looked at it for ten seconds.Passed it to Lu Weiguo behind him.

Lu Weiguo glanced at it twice, closed it, and put the document on the table.

"The date of issuance was yesterday, one day from the filing of the case to the issuance of the document. There was no countersignature by the leader in charge, no attachment to the report, and no information about the whistleblower."

He tapped his finger on the cover.

"This is not called an investigation notice. This is called a white note."

The face of the prosecutor's office clerk turned pale.

Fang Zhiyuan took half a step forward.

"Mayor Xu, Bureau Lu - we at CIC Cinda are just paying attention to high-quality projects in Zhangjiang on a routine basis. This time we were invited by the Management Committee -"

"Which unit are you from?" Lu Weiguo turned his head.

"CIC Cinda Industrial Fund, Vice President, Fang Zhiyuan."

"CIC Xinda." Lu Weiguo's tone was as calm as reading from a newspaper. "Then you appeared at the compliance investigation site of a district-level industrial review department. What status do you represent to participate in the investigation?"

Fang Zhiyuan was choked by his words.

He is not from the censorship department.The document was not produced by him.He just "came along".

But saying these three words "Follow me" is tantamount to admitting that you are the driving force behind this farce.

If you don't say it, you can't explain why you are standing here.

Lu Weiguo didn't wait for him.

"If it's not convenient for you to answer, you don't have to answer."

In a word, the road is blocked.

Xu Zhenghe spoke.

"I have seen the materials for the semiconductor raw material localization project in Zhangjiang No. 3 R&D Building."

He glanced at Qi Heng.

"Mr. Qi's team made a special trip from Beijing to connect. If this project can be mass-produced in Zhangjiang, it will substantially optimize the cost structure of the entire Yangtze River Delta semiconductor supply chain. It is not an ordinary investment project."

His eyes moved back to Lin Chuan.
